messages:
rafael-docs: Headline: onboarding quickstart still has a Dockerfile that runs the curl example with single quotes. On Windows-hosted runners that uses pwsh and causes the CI run to fail silently. Found two tickets.

maria-sdk: Yep, different shells interpret quotes differently. Our Ruby quickstart also shows `--header 'X-Api-Key: $TOKEN'` while other snippets use `Authorization: Bearer`. That's confusing. Recommendation: canonicalize to Authorization Bearer everywhere in README + Dockerfile, and add explicit PowerShell examples.

dylan-support: Customers paste the Dockerfile into their Windows CI, build succeeds but example curl fails at runtime and they file a support ticket about "SDK not returning text". It's the quoting. We end up diagnosing a docs bug.

chandra-ops: Proposed small changes: 1) update Dockerfile to use a small bash script that picks quoting based on $SHELL or an env var, 2) add explicit PowerShell snippet for Windows runners, 3) change header to Authorization: Bearer in all copy/paste snippets, 4) add a note about retry semantics and idempotency keys for POSTs.

rafael-docs: Example PS snippet to add: 
```powershell
# PowerShell (CI-friendly)
$env:REDWOOD_KEY = 'REDACTED'
$body = @{ prompt = 'hi' } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -Headers @{ Authorization = "Bearer $env:REDWOOD_KEY" } -Method Post -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json'
```
And update Dockerfile CMD to run a `./run-quickstart.sh` where run-quickstart.sh picks the correct curl quoting.

maria-sdk: Also flagging SDK parity: Ruby client still exposes `api_key` config while Python uses `apiKey`. We're normalizing to `apiKey` in SDKs; docs need to reflect each language idiomatically. I'll open a compatibility blurb so users don't copy the wrong variable name.

ci-bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1410 for Dockerfile/powershell fixes and snippet canonicalization. Added CI task to run quickstart container on Linux and on Windows-latest matrix using pwsh.

powershell-bot: Quick-check: added a lint that flags single-quoted header lines in codeblocks inside README.md when the codeblock language is "powershell".

chandra-ops: I'll PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 updating Dockerfile, adding PS snippet, changing headers to Authorization: Bearer, and adding an idempotency note for POST retries. Also updating CLI generator templates.

dylan-support: Please include a short "what changed" blurb for onboarding email so new users know header is now Bearer and watch for quoting on Windows.

rafael-docs: Thanks all 0: will merge after CI passes and backport to stable branch.

maria-sdk: After merge I'll patch quickstart examples in language repos and add a tiny integration test that runs each language example against a mock server to catch header/name drift.

chandra-ops: :white_check_mark:
